+import pytest
+
+from marshmallow import Schema, fields
+
+
+class ProfileSchema(Schema):
+    name = fields.String()
+    age = fields.Integer()
+
+
+class ChildSchema(Schema):
+    profile = fields.Nested(ProfileSchema)
+    tag = fields.String()
+    id = fields.Integer()
+
+
+PAYLOAD = {
+    "profile": {"name": "Ada", "age": 37},
+    "tag": "kept",
+    "id": 9,
+}
+
+
+def dump_child(field, payload=PAYLOAD):
+    return field.serialize("child", {"child": payload})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("warm", [False, True])
+def test_dotted_only_matches_class_without_mutating_source(warm):
+    source = ChildSchema()
+    if warm:
+        assert source.dump(PAYLOAD) == PAYLOAD
+    profile = source.fields["profile"]
+    expected = {"profile": {"name": "Ada"}}
+    assert dump_child(fields.Nested(ChildSchema, only=("profile.name",))) == expected
+    selected = fields.Nested(source, only=("profile.name",))
+    assert dump_child(selected) == expected
+    assert source.only is None
+    assert source.exclude == set()
+    assert profile.only is None
+    assert profile.exclude == ()
+    assert set(source.fields) == {"profile", "tag", "id"}
+    assert source.dump(PAYLOAD) == PAYLOAD
+    assert dump_child(selected) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("warm", [False, True])
+def test_dotted_only_intersects_existing_nested_selection(warm):
+    source = ChildSchema(only=("profile.name", "tag"))
+    original = {"profile": {"name": "Ada"}, "tag": "kept"}
+    if warm:
+        assert source.dump(PAYLOAD) == original
+    selected = fields.Nested(
+        source, only=("profile.name", "profile.age", "id")
+    )
+    assert dump_child(selected) == {"profile": {"name": "Ada"}}
+    assert set(source.only) == {"profile", "tag"}
+    assert set(source.fields["profile"].only) == {"name"}
+    assert source.dump(PAYLOAD) == original
+    disjoint = fields.Nested(source, only=("profile.age",))
+    assert dump_child(disjoint) == {"profile": {}}
+    assert dump_child(selected) == {"profile": {"name": "Ada"}}
+    assert source.dump(PAYLOAD) == original
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("warm", [False, True])
+def test_two_wrappers_keep_independent_nested_selections(warm):
+    source = ChildSchema()
+    if warm:
+        source.dump(PAYLOAD)
+    name = fields.Nested(source, only=("profile.name",))
+    age = fields.Nested(source, only=("profile.age",))
+    assert dump_child(name) == {"profile": {"name": "Ada"}}
+    assert dump_child(age) == {"profile": {"age": 37}}
+    assert dump_child(name) == {"profile": {"name": "Ada"}}
+    assert source.dump(PAYLOAD) == PAYLOAD
+
+
+def test_dotted_only_respects_instance_top_level_options_and_many():
+    source = ChildSchema(many=True, only=("profile", "tag"), exclude=("tag",))
+    original = [{"profile": {"name": "Ada", "age": 37}}]
+    assert source.dump([PAYLOAD]) == original
+    selected = fields.Nested(source, only=("profile.name", "tag", "id"))
+    assert dump_child(selected, [PAYLOAD]) == [{"profile": {"name": "Ada"}}]
+    assert source.many is True
+    assert set(source.only) == {"profile", "tag"}
+    assert source.exclude == {"tag"}
+    assert source.dump([PAYLOAD]) == original

spec.question:
Make dotted `only` selections work when `fields.Nested` receives an existing schema instance. For a `Child` schema with a `profile = fields.Nested(Profile)` field, where `Profile` declares `name` and `age`, both `fields.Nested(Child, only=("profile.name",))` and `fields.Nested(Child(), only=("profile.name",))` should serialize just `profile.name`.

Restrictions already present on a supplied instance must remain authoritative: requested selections intersect with its existing selections at both the top level and within nested fields, including producing an empty nested object when those child selections are disjoint. Preserve the existing `exclude` and `many` behavior. Applying a selection must not alter the supplied instance's options or subsequent dumps, whether or not it has already been used to dump data. Two Nested fields using the same supplied instance with different selections must also remain independent.

Return a unified diff against the repository source files, without changing existing tests.
